scenes.setting: A split-screen setup. The top panel is a bright, modern cafe. The bottom panel is a simple room with a plain wall.

panels.panel_visual_description: A medium close-up shot of a female humanoid robot, Character A, sitting comfortably in a black leather armchair. She is in a bright, airy cafe setting with large windows behind her showing greenery and a pagoda-like structure. On a small table next to her is a purple mug with a latte art heart on top. The lighting is soft and natural. Her expression is calm and attentive.

A medium close-up shot of a young South Asian man, Character B, sitting and looking directly at the camera. He is in a plainly decorated room with a neutral-colored wall behind him. The lighting is simple and direct. His expressions change throughout the scene from frustrated and anxious to hopeful and smiling.

scenes.visual_description: A vertically split-screen video. The top panel shows Character A, a female AI robot, in a cafe. The bottom panel shows Character B, a young male student, in a simple room. They are having a conversation. Large, single-word text overlays appear in the middle of the screen, synchronized with the dialogue.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: तुम्हारा वाइवा कैसा गया? [How was your viva (oral exam)?]
Character B says: अच्छा नहीं गया। मुझे सारे आंसर्स आते थे, फिर भी आंसर नहीं दे पाया। [It didn't go well. I knew all the answers, but still couldn't answer.]
Character A says: क्यों, ऐसा क्या हुआ? [Why, what happened?]
Character B says: वो मैं आंसर देते हुए नर्वस हो गया क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश अच्छे से नहीं आती। [Well, I got nervous while answering because I don't know English well.]
Character A says: तो इंग्लिश सीख क्यों नहीं लेते? [Then why don't you learn English?]
Character B says: मेरे साथ कोई प्रैक्टिस करने वाला नहीं है ना। [I don't have anyone to practice with.]
Character A says: तो तुम मेरे साथ प्रैक्टिस करो ना। [Then practice with me.]
Character B says: मेरे पास प्रैक्टिस करने का टाइम भी कहां है? [Where do I even have the time to practice?]
Character A says: मेरे साथ रोज़ बस 15 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करो एंड कुछ ही दिनों में तुम्हारी इंग्लिश बिल्कुल अच्छी हो जाएगी। [Just practice with me for 15 minutes every day, and in a few days, your English will become very good.]
Character B says: अच्छा? पर ये तो महंगा होगा ना? [Really? But this must be expensive, right?]
